chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masroor (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Muhammad ibn Amer quoted his uncle Abdullah ibn Amer, on the authority of Al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, on the authority of Abi Ayoob, on the authority of Abi Hamzah, on the authority of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussein (peace be upon them both) said:

Four [characteristics] in which whoever possesses them, his Islam is perfected, his sins are eliminated, and he will meet his Lord, Exalted and Glorious, while He is pleased with him: Whoever fulfills for God, Exalted and Glorious, what he imposes upon himself for the people, and his tongue is truthful with the people, and he is modest of every ugly deed before God and before the people, and his character is good with his family.
ai.seo_question: What are the four characteristics that perfect Islam and eliminate sins according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights these four traits as the culmination of *Iman* (faith) manifesting in social and domestic conduct, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of belief and ethical action (*Amal*). This narration underscores that true piety is not merely internal but is validated through consistent honesty, modesty (*Haya*), and benevolence (*Husn al-Khuluq*) in interactions with both the community and the family. Such comprehensive character perfection ensures that the believer meets their Lord with a clean slate of sins and divine satisfaction.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-50 Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Masroor - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Muhammad ibn Amer quoted his uncle Abdullah ibn Amer, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Mahboob, on the authority of Abi Ayoob, on the authority of Abi Hamzih that Abi Ja’far al-Baqir (MGB), on the authority of Imam Ali ibn al-Hussein as-Sajjad (MGB), “Possessing the following four characteristics will perfect your Islam and eliminate your sins, and you will meet your Lord while He is pleased with you:
1- Fulfilling your promises to the people,2- Being honest with the people,3- Being ashamed of what is shameful in the sight of God and the people,4- Being good-tempered with your family."
